svg.title: Crackscan system architecture
svg.desc: Three-tier architecture: React + TypeScript client, FastAPI backend, TensorFlow/Keras CNN, connected by HTTP POST and WebSockets.
svg.text: System Architecture · Three-Tier: Client → Server → Brain
Captures input, renders the UI & live results
Decodes images, formats tensors, returns predictions
The math engine that classifies every image
The Stage — canvas, CSS scan line, corner brackets
Verdict Panel — label, big % score, tick meter
setInterval grabs a frame → compressed Base64 JPEG
Persistent link · sends Base64 · live state updates
Lets React (:3000) talk to FastAPI (:8000) securely
Multipart file → read into memory (no disk)
Identical pipeline for the upload and live routes → CNN
Augmentation: rotation · zoom · shift · horizontal flip
then the next frame in 500 ms
↻ loops continuously while the camera is on
Crackscan · CNN Surface Crack Detection — HTTP for uploads, WebSockets for live camera streaming
